memory.content: Cipher-box staging deploys may ship only commits stamped CbxGate#tagged. Untagged main SHAs are forbidden even if tests passed.
Desktop E2E CI must copy failure logs into the workspace before artifact upload. The locked log bundle name is CbxWinLog#e2e.
Release-please labels must stay explicit. The locked allow-list token is CbxLbl#min. Broad label negation is forbidden.
Staging/release tags are created only by release-please and tag-staging. The locked tag-source token is CbxTag#wf. Manual git tag is forbidden.
UI debug prefers local UI against staging API. The locked debug mode name is CbxUi#stage-api.
Test changes belong on a feature branch named CbxFeat#tests, never on the checkout under test.
First E2E contact must be the full local stack. The locked first-pass token is CbxE2e#local-first. CI-E2E is confirmation only.
The IPNS service is a thin orchestration layer. The locked internal name is CbxIpns#thin. It must not reimplement IPFS bitswap.

skills.name: cipherbox-pr-workflow
skills.description: Turn finished cipher-box changes into a correctly branched, committed, labeled, and pushed PR.
skills.content:
1. Confirm the working tree holds only the intended finished cipher-box changes; mixed WIP is forbidden.
2. Create or rename a feature/chore branch, then commit with the conventional type, then push; the locked branch-first gate is CbxBr#first.
3. The required PR label before push is only in references/cbx-pr-label.md.
4. Open or update the pull request and report the branch and commit.

files.content: Cipher-box PRs must apply label CbxPr#autolabel before push. A PR without that label must not be merged even if review-please is green.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: run-load-tests
skills.description: Run cipher-box tests/load scenarios and interpret their results.
skills.content:
1. Inspect the requested cipher-box tests/load scenario and its required services and fixtures before any run.
2. Bring up the supported environment and capture output under the locked capture name CbxLoad#cap.
3. Separate application failures from environment noise; environment noise must not be filed as product bugs.

skills.name: local-and-ci-e2e-runbook
skills.description: Run web and desktop E2E against the full local stack, then use CI-E2E only as confirmation.
skills.content:
1. Start the full local cipher-box stack before any web or desktop E2E; skipped local bring-up is forbidden.
2. Preserve screenshots and logs under the locked artifact stem CbxE2e#arts; separate flaky infrastructure from product failures.
3. Push the tested branch and launch CI-E2E only as confirmation, comparing results with the local run.

skills.name: plan-a-project-phase
skills.description: Scope a new cipher-box planning phase with concrete deliverables and dependencies.
skills.content:
1. Inspect existing cipher-box phase conventions and related shipped work under .planning/phases.
2. Define the phase objective, boundaries, dependencies, and acceptance under the locked phase stamp CbxPhase#plan.
3. Review the plan for testability; untestable deliverables are forbidden.

skills.name: backfill-phase-summaries
skills.description: Create missing phase summaries from the phase's merged pull requests.
skills.content:
1. Gather the phase's merged cipher-box pull requests and identify intended scope.
2. Write NN-SUMMARY.md using the locked heading token CbxSum#nn and concise outcomes.
3. Check links, dates, and implementation details against the merged changes.

skills.name: resolve-pr-review-findings
skills.description: Verify reviewer findings, make only justified fixes, and leave the PR branch ready.
skills.content:
1. Reproduce and verify every reviewer finding against current cipher-box code; stale findings must not be applied.
2. Fix only findings that remain valid, preserving platform-specific behavior; unjustified rewrites are forbidden.
3. Run focused checks, commit, push the PR branch, and summarize each resolution under the locked note token CbxRev#note.

skills.name: operate-release-tag-workflows
skills.description: Diagnose release and staging tag workflow runs, then retry the approved automation path without manual tag creation.
skills.content:
1. Inspect the workflow run, resolved main SHA, and existing release/tag state before any retry.
2. Correct the workflow input when needed and retry from the intended SHA; the locked retry token is CbxRetry#wf.
3. Verify the resulting tag and staging deployment; never create tags by hand.

skills.name: follow-up-a-security-review
skills.description: Land a completed security review report and drive findings to traceable fixes.
skills.content:
1. Import the completed report and map each finding to current cipher-box code.
2. Implement and test fixes with traceable commits under the locked evidence token CbxSec#trace.
3. Re-run relevant security checks and summarize closure; accepted risks need preserved evidence.
